## Professional Profile

::: {.cv-profile}
Statistician with a Master's Degree in Applied Statistics and Data Science, currently pursuing a PhD in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at Universidad El Bosque. Works across advanced statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning, and data mining — including dimensionality reduction, imputation, anomaly detection, classification, and regression — and builds automated data workflows with data-quality validation.
:::
